title: Bevels and shading
summary: How you bevel hard edges and set up normals: bevel widths, segments, limits, weighted normals, sharp edges.

request.brief: Model a mostly boxy hard-surface prop (a junction box, a power supply, a radio body) and shade it exactly the way you ship it: keep your bevel modifiers and normal setup live, don't apply them. Include at least one big chamfer and one small edge so both sizes show.
must_include: Live bevel setup the way you normally use it (modifier, weights or geometry)
Your normal setup (weighted normals, sharp edges, smooth by angle) left in place
Both a large and a small bevel
